text:
maddie_marketing: Quick thread — proposing a compact PLG experiment tied to the LaunchLoop social push + workshop. Focus: test whether credit nudges + ready-made templates increase first-successful-prompt and micro-conversion into guided workshop attendance.

marc_growth: love this. what's the hypothesis and primary metric?

maddie_marketing: Hypothesis: credits + curated prompt pack will raise 7-day prompt-success by ~5-7pp and increase workshop RSVP by ~8%. Primary metric = prompt.execute with template_id within 7 days. Secondary = workshop RSVP rate and time-to-first-success.

rachel_product: routing? need to ensure inbound UTM + creative variant captured so we can tie post -> behavior.

maddie_marketing: plan: tag signups with cohort=launchloop-pilot and creative_variant=postA/postB. auto-enroll first 2.5k or 21 days.

emma_design: creative note: two launch posts: "benchmark narrative" (latency/cost proof) vs "quick feature story" (how to ship a feature in 10m). assets will be square for socials + short caption. will drop drafts by EOD. :art:

marc_growth: allocation thoughts? baseline vs credits-only vs credits+templates+nudge?

theo_analytics: power quick calc: baseline est 16% success. to detect +6pp at 80% power we need ~1500 users per arm. with 2.5k cap, bias to treatment: 20/40/40 works. I'll build dashboard and SQL cohorts.

maddie_marketing: ok — we can stretch credits to 3k if finance approves. dynamic cap open.

rachel_product: onboarding path: deliver 4 tiny templates at signup (summarize, rewrite, brainstorm, code-assist). show a one-line example and quick "Try" CTA. if no usage in 48h, queue a micro-webinar invite + 1 follow-up email.

emma_design: modal copy draft idea: "Welcome — try one of our starter prompts. Get instant examples and credits to play." Will add example micro-copies.

marc_growth: manual outreach: plan to do a short human touch for top 100 signups (high activity or large org emails). I'll coordinate.

theo_analytics: please add experiment_id to signup and prompt events. Also include anonymized_use opt-in tag if we include research checkbox.

maddie_marketing: good call on opt-in. we'll include a clear checkbox in the modal: "Share anonymized prompt usage to improve templates".

deploy_bot: experiment created: exp.launchloop.1777777777 | cohorts: baseline/credits/full | allocation: 20/40/40 | tag experiment_id=exp.launchloop.1777777777

maddie_marketing: Action items:
- maddie_marketing: confirm budget + doc (today)
- emma_design: post assets + modal copy (EOD)
- rachel_product: implement delivery + follow-up rules (ETA Wed)
- theo_analytics: dashboard + SQL cohorts + power calc (ETA Wed)
- marc_growth: manual outreach list for top 100 (ETA Fri)

marc_growth: noted. will prepare outreach snippets.

theo_analytics: will post a lightweight dashboard link once events start flowing.

maddie_marketing: unless objections i'll greenlight tomorrow AM. ping me here if blocked. :seedling:
